The '''Fenel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Fenel]], the homeworld of the [[Fenelar]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the system was created as the original system of the Fenelar.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31061022|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2010-07-06|time=7:48 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802120406/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-147}}</ref>
